Dharma.title: Dharma
Dharma.definition: Religious duty; righteousness; cosmic law; the natural order of the universe

Bhakti.title: Bhakti
Bhakti.definition: Devotion; loving service to the Supreme Lord; the path of devotional surrender

Yoga.title: Yoga
Yoga.definition: Union; skill in action; spiritual discipline; methods of connecting with the divine

Atman.title: Atman
Atman.definition: The eternal individual soul; the self; the divine essence within all beings

Brahman.title: Brahman
Brahman.definition: The ultimate reality; the absolute consciousness; the source of all existence

Karma.title: Karma
Karma.definition: Action and its consequences; the universal law of cause and effect

Moksha.title: Moksha
Moksha.definition: Liberation; freedom from the cycle of rebirth; union with the divine
